facts.raw_span: A 46-year-old Japanese woman
with a history of epilepsy
redness and swelling of the right breast
erythema and swelling in the lower right breast
Ultrasound revealed a 54 × 41 × 31 mm low-echo mass with partially unclear margins in the outer right breast
Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma (no special type), high grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver
consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer
She received four cycles of FEC chemotherapy
lesions nearly disappeared
a clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
a persistent headache

concepts.why: Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma and whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in multiple areas, consistent with stage IV breast cancer
A persistent headache and a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe, in a patient with a history of breast cancer, suggest a brain metastasis
The patient has a history of epilepsy
Redness and swelling of the right breast, with erythema and swelling in the lower right breast, are consistent with inflammatory breast cancer
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in multiple areas, consistent with metastatic breast cancer
The patient received trastuzumab and achieved a clinical complete response, but the cancer may still be resistant to trastuzumab
A persistent headache and a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe could also suggest a meningioma, although this is less likely given the patient's history of breast cancer
A persistent headache and a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe could also suggest a glioblastoma, although this is less likely given the patient's history of breast cancer
